font.reason: Amiri is a high-contrast Naskh, the editorial serif voice that replaces ui-serif/Georgia 600; single weight, so the semi-bold is rebuilt with a 2.5px WebkitTextStroke (accent word 3.5px). Markazi Text was tried first and rendered monoline/sans-like. Vazirmatn for the small neutral sub-line replacing the monospace uppercase tracked line (Vazir Code looks stretched on Persian prose). Both loaded via FaFonts.

comps.translatedSummary: «تمام پژوهش‌های تیم شما، همه در یک جا.» with accent word «یک»; sub-line «۵ از ۳۱ مورد امروز دریافت شد».

rtlDecisions.why: flex row under direction:rtl: first word is right-most, cascade runs right to left; per-WORD units only, ZWNJ kept inside «پژوهش‌های»
Persian has no italic; slanting breaks joining. Emphasis = amber colour + thicker stroke
transform-origin right: grows from the reading-start edge
digit strip now Persian digits ۰-۹, same delay/22f bezier; vertical roll is physical, kept
digit first at right, label follows, reads «۵ از ۳۱ ...»

rtlDecisions.what: Centered composition, radial paper glow, 8f fade-out, scale/blur stamp

rtlDecisions.why: Persian is wider and taller: balanced break «تمام پژوهش‌های تیم شما،» / «همه در یک جا.», dots/ascenders do not collide, Amiri word gap clear

rasterTextHandling: No raster or image assets in this card.
concerns: Original had 8 words; Persian keeps 8 word units so beats (delay 4+i*4, underline 16-34f, digit 12f) are identical. Amiri's ZWNJ gap in «پژوهش‌های» is slightly wide. Karaoke-like 'یک' tail touches 'در' swash slightly at rest.
